dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product moves the size of its own content when it changes — a reply that grows by a line, a detail that opens, a row that goes — instead of letting what follows jump, and wants every such change to take one tempo, longer for a longer distance, apart from its changes of state and its disclosures.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a size transition reads: how long a change of its size takes for a short distance, how much longer each further distance step makes it, the distance step itself, the longest a change may take, and the curve. It draws nothing: no color, edge, corner or padding.
rules: The time grows with the distance: duration up to distance-step, plus duration-step for each further distance-step begun, never more than duration-max.
Where motion is reduced a change of size is made at once; no token restyles that.
Restyle the tempo of every size transition of a product here; an instance's duration is for the one place that needs another.

duration.$description: How long a change of size takes over a distance of up to distance-step: the role of a box that changes its size in place.

duration-step.$description: How much longer a change takes for each further distance-step it moves, so that a large change does not look hurried beside a small one.

distance-step.$description: The distance by which a change's time grows by one duration-step.

duration-max.$description: The longest a change of size takes, however far it moves: the role of a large change of size, so that a far change does not keep the person waiting.

easing.$description: The curve of a change of size: something that changes its size in place.
